_doc: Core LANGUAGE-AGNOSTIC concepts of communication — a complete-enough SEMANTIC BASIS (NSM semantic primes + frame-semantic roles + Halliday/Searle speech functions) that the agent SEEDS and a specific language's grammar is then TAUGHT to map onto (renderer / W_j principle: one meaning, many serializations). The completeness is a BASIS claim, not a vocabulary one: finite primes + the composition grammar (the generator) express unbounded meaning. NO surface words — pure concepts + participant roles. Many primes also occur in domain seeds (psychology/logic_modal/...); the loader LINKS those into this basis rather than duplicating, so `communication` is the single grammar target.

concepts.name: identity
concepts.gloss: two referring expressions denote the SAME entity (equation). 'A is B' where A and B co-refer.

concepts.name: attribution
concepts.gloss: an entity HAS a property/quality. 'X is P'.

concepts.name: class_membership
concepts.gloss: an entity is an INSTANCE of a kind (is-a). 'X is a K'.

concepts.name: definition
concepts.gloss: the UNIVERSAL STRUCTURE OF A DEFINITION (Aristotelian genus-differentia): FRAME? REGISTER? TERM (definiendum) is-a GENUS that DIFFERENTIA. EVERY part carries MEANING — nothing is strippable. The GENUS is the broader concept the TERM is a kind of (the TERM's grounding parent / built_from = the HEAD NOUN of the predicate noun phrase after the copula 'is a/an/the'); a definition is thus a class_membership (the TERM is-a GENUS) carrying the extra grounding burden. The DIFFERENTIA is what distinguishes the TERM within the genus (a relative clause 'that/which ...', a participle 'used for ...', a prepositional tail 'of ...') and is OPTIONAL for grounding — you ground on the GENUS. The FRAME is a leading domain adjunct ('In mathematics,', 'In music,') naming WHICH WORLD/MICROTHEORY the concept is grounded in (manifold-in-mathematics vs manifold-in-plumbing are DIFFERENT groundings) — grounding is frame-relative, the frame says WHERE to ground (which Mt). The REGISTER is an epistemic adjunct ('roughly speaking,', 'formally,') naming HOW PRECISE/CONFIDENT the definition is — a hedge (roughly/loosely = APPROXIMATE, lower confidence) vs an exactness marker (formally/precisely = EXACT, full confidence): the epistemic-confidence band of the grounding. The FRAME and REGISTER are NOT stripped — they are COMPREHENDED into {frame, register} and the grounding USES them (attach in the frame's Mt, at the register's confidence). ONE structure parses ANY definitional sentence (a linguistic universal). 'In mathematics, roughly speaking, a manifold is a topological space that locally resembles Euclidean space' -> frame=mathematics, register=approximate, definiendum=manifold, genus=topological_space, differentia=the rest; ground manifold built_from topological_space IN the mathematics frame AT approximate confidence.

structure._doc: The genus-differentia STRUCTURE as graph DATA the agent HOLDS — the markers comprehension reads to extract the genus AND the frame AND the register from ANY definitional sentence, generally (not a list of surface forms). A definition = FRAME-adjunct* REGISTER-adjunct* COPULA TERM=def, then GENUS_NP (head noun, optional adjectives) up to a DIFFERENTIA marker; the rest is differentia (a label, not required to ground). The leading comma-delimited adjuncts are NOT discarded: a FRAME adjunct ('in <field>' / 'in the field of <field>') -> frame=<field> (which Mt to ground in); a REGISTER adjunct (a hedge / exactness word) -> register=approximate|exact (the epistemic-confidence band). NOTHING stripped — every part is comprehended into structure.
structure._research_register_doc: RESEARCH REGISTER (the dense 'Let X be Y. A Z is a W ...' prose) held as graph DATA. A PREAMBLE (a leading 'Let X be Y' / 'Given a W' / 'Suppose ...' / 'Fix ...' / 'Consider ...' clause or sentence, marked by preamble_markers) BINDS the context the definition ranges over (X is-a Y via preamble_copula) and is NOT the definition of the TERM — it is COMPREHENDED into bindings then SKIPPED to find the sentence that defines the headword. A connective_skip word ('then'/'thus') leads the term definition AFTER the preamble and is skipped to reach it. The CONSTRUCTIVE forms (constructive_copula 'consists of' / 'is given by'; constructive_markers 'together with' / 'equipped with') introduce the genus like 'is' does, the parts/structure tail kept as constructive differentia. NOTHING is stripped: the preamble bindings are returned as context. This is the research register, learned the SAME way as the genus-differentia / frame / register / notation — as constructions (graph data) the order-N comprehension applies.

partitive_hedges._doc: A PARTITIVE HEDGE ('a kind of X' / 'a sort of X' / 'a type of X' / 'a form of X' / 'a variety of X' / 'a class of X' / 'a species of X') is BOTH a genus (head PAST the partitive: the genus is X, not 'kind') AND a register hedge (the partitive itself is approximate — it asserts membership softly). When the genus head is one of these partitive nouns followed by 'of <X>', comprehend genus=<X> AND register=approximate. NOTHING dropped: the partitive carries the hedge.

expected_slots._doc: The GENERATIVE MODEL a competent reader holds of a definition — the slots EXPECTED, each read PRESENT | ABSENT | DIFFERENT against expectation. ABSENCE and DIFFERENCE are SIGNAL (prediction-error = information), not a null default. frame: a leading domain adjunct — ABSENT means inherited from the active discourse frame / universal (comprehended, not null); DIFFERENT from the term's known frame ('In music, a manifold ...' when the agent holds manifold-in-mathematics) = a SENSE-SHIFT (homonym, a distinct sense — do NOT overwrite). register: an epistemic adjunct/marker — ABSENT (unmarked) = the CANONICAL, asserted-as-fact case (EXACT, full confidence — a comprehended SIGNAL 'stated as definitional truth', not a missing value); PRESENT-and-a-hedge = a DEVIATION (APPROXIMATE, lower confidence). genus: the broader kind the term is-a — DIFFERENT from what the agent already holds for the term = SURPRISE (flag for re-evaluation, ground but do not silently overwrite a held grounding).

register_band._doc: REGISTER -> {status, confidence_band}. The UNMARKED case is the comprehended CANONICAL status (asserted as definitional truth) at FULL confidence — NOT a missing value. A hedge is a DEVIATION to APPROXIMATE at a lower band. A coarse ordered band (driven by held data, honest two-and-a-bit levels): canonical/exact/technical = 1.0 (full); approximate (roughly/loosely) = 0.85; informal (informally/intuitively) = 0.8.

register_class._doc: Map each register MARKER word to its register CLASS (the band key above). Exactness/technical markers -> exact (canonical-strength, but explicitly marked). Hedges -> approximate, except the softer 'informally/intuitively' -> informal (a slightly lower band). Absence of any marker is handled as 'canonical' by the comprehension (the unmarked asserted-fact case).

domain_mt_map._doc: Resolve a FRAME name to a Microtheory: exact name-match first (handled in code), then this known-domain map (the frame field word -> the Mt name the agent is likely to hold). A coarse name-match — the honest remaining coarseness. If neither resolves, the frame is recorded + a genls toward the nearest held domain Mt rather than dropped.

concepts.name: relation
concepts.gloss: a relational role links an OWNER to a VALUE: the <relation> of <owner> is <value> (capital-of, author-of). The core of 'X is the N of Y'.

concepts.name: possession
concepts.gloss: an entity HAS another entity. 'X has Y'.

concepts.name: existence
concepts.gloss: an entity EXISTS (optionally somewhere). 'there is X'.

concepts.name: location_state
concepts.gloss: an entity is located AT a place (stative). 'X is at L'.

concepts.name: part_whole
concepts.gloss: an entity is a PART of a whole. 'X is part of Y'.

concepts.name: cognition
concepts.gloss: an experiencer THINKS something (entertains a proposition). NSM THINK.

concepts.name: knowledge
concepts.gloss: an experiencer KNOWS something (holds it as true/grounded). NSM KNOW.

concepts.name: belief
concepts.gloss: an experiencer BELIEVES something (holds it likely, not certain).

concepts.name: volition
concepts.gloss: an experiencer WANTS something/to-do. NSM WANT (+ DON'T WANT).

concepts.name: sensation
concepts.gloss: an experiencer FEELS something (bodily/emotional). NSM FEEL.

concepts.name: perception_visual
concepts.gloss: an experiencer SEES a stimulus. NSM SEE.

concepts.name: perception_auditory
concepts.gloss: an experiencer HEARS a stimulus. NSM HEAR.

concepts.name: communication_act
concepts.gloss: an agent SAYS words (to someone) — the basis of REPORTED SPEECH. NSM SAY/WORDS.

concepts.name: signification
concepts.gloss: a sign MEANS a content (X means Y).

concepts.name: source
concepts.gloss: the PROVENANCE of knowledge: knowledge comes FROM a source, and WHERE/WHO/HOW it came from is PART OF WHAT IT MEANS and how firmly it is held. A source has a GENRE (what kind of work it is), an AUTHORITY/VOICE (WHO speaks — a person, a community, a consensus), a MANNER/REGISTER (HOW it speaks), a RELIABILITY (the epistemic weight it lends what it grounds), and CONVENTIONS (HOW to read it). A competent reader knows what they are reading — the source frames the read AND sets the epistemic weight. Grounded in knowledge/belief (the epistemic cluster): a source is what an experiencer KNOWS something FROM. Provenance is part of grounding.

concepts.name: reference_work
concepts.gloss: a SOURCE whose genre is a curated body of knowledge organised for LOOKUP (a dictionary, an encyclopedia, an atlas). A reference work is consulted, not read cover-to-cover; it is generally reliable for ESTABLISHED knowledge within its scope and weaker on the obscure/contested/recent. is-a source.

concepts.name: encyclopedia
concepts.gloss: a REFERENCE WORK that is a TERTIARY (not primary/original) reference of CONSENSUS / established knowledge, organised by TOPIC, written from a NEUTRAL point of view (NPOV), with claims CITED to sources. Each article's LEAD sentence DEFINES the topic; a leading 'In <field>,' scopes the domain; the bold term is the definiendum. Epistemic weight = consensus-tertiary: MORE than conjecture, ATTRIBUTED (not self-derived), reliable for established knowledge, weaker on obscure/recent/contested. is-a reference_work.

conventions._doc: The CONVENTIONS of the encyclopedia genre held as graph DATA — the agent reads these to know HOW TO READ an article (the lead IS the definition; 'In <field>,' IS the domain frame) and WHAT EPISTEMIC WEIGHT to assign. NOT hardcoded in Python: the read consults this structure.

concepts.name: wikipedia
concepts.gloss: the ENCYCLOPEDIA at en.wikipedia.org: crowd-edited (WHO = the editorial COMMUNITY / CONSENSUS, no single author), freely editable, generally reliable for ESTABLISHED knowledge and WEAKER on obscure/recent/contested topics (no expert gatekeeping). HOW = the encyclopedic register + the encyclopedia conventions (lead-defines, NPOV, cited). WHERE = the specific article (the location of the knowledge). WHEN = the structured-dump SNAPSHOT date — provenance has a time. is-a encyclopedia.

provenance._doc: The PROVENANCE template the agent attaches to everything it grounds by reading Wikipedia — WHERE/WHO/HOW/WHAT/WHEN + the source's epistemic status, read off this held concept (NOT hardcoded in Python). WHERE is filled per-article (the title); the rest is the held understanding of the source.

concepts.name: generative_source
concepts.gloss: a SOURCE whose genre is a GENERATIVE LANGUAGE MODEL: it PRODUCES fluent text by next-token generation over a training distribution, not by curation or attribution. WHO = a model (a compression of a training corpus / crowd), no single author and no editorial consensus. HOW = generative register — plausible, confident, sometimes wrong; FLUENCY IS NOT EVIDENCE. WHEN = training-cutoff-dated (it does not know past its cutoff). Epistemic weight = SELF-PUBLISHED, calibrated: BELOW an attested reference (encyclopedia); its claims must be CORROBORATED before they assert alone, and it is a WITNESS the reader can outgrow (demotable when the reader's own faculties contradict it). is-a source.

conventions._doc: The CONVENTIONS of the generative-source genre held as graph DATA — how the agent reads an LLM output and what epistemic weight to assign. NOT hardcoded in Python: the read consults this structure.

concepts.name: qwen3
concepts.gloss: the QWEN3 family of generative language models (here empero-ai/Qwen3.8-4B-Distill, Qwen3.8 distilled into the Qwen3.5-4B architecture). WHO = a model (Alibaba/Qwen lineage), no single author. HOW = next-token generation; the generative register + generative-source conventions (fluency-is-not-evidence, corroborate-before-assert). WHEN = its training cutoff. Reaped content (is-a / relational facts, concept judgments, process transforms) enters the agent's grounding as a WITNESS at a CALIBRATED self-published band — BELOW an attested reference, corroborate-before-assert, per-tier trust carried on the reaped edges (block 331/332). is-a generative_source.

provenance._doc: The PROVENANCE template the agent attaches to everything it grounds from reaped Qwen3 content — WHO/HOW/WHEN + the source's calibrated epistemic status, read off this held concept (NOT hardcoded in Python). WHERE is filled per-claim (the elicitation prompt / relation); the rest is the held understanding of the source.

concepts.name: temporal_entity
concepts.gloss: a SOURCE (or any entity) that has a HISTORY: it is not a static genre but an entity whose STATE (its name, owner, conventions, trust) CHANGES over a TIMELINE of dated EVENTS, each event a GROUNDED FACT carrying a WHEN and grounding in its own concepts. The CONTEXT of an artifact FROM such a source is NOT a flat tag but the GROUNDING CONE of the entity TIME-SLICED to the artifact's date — composed over the events with when <= the date. A 2015 artifact and a 2024 artifact from the SAME surface form DERIVE DIFFERENT contexts because a different set of events is in their cone. is-a source. Grounding is time-relative: the WHEN selects the entity's state.

concepts.name: elon_musk
concepts.gloss: a person (entrepreneur) grounding in business/finance/politics — the acquirer and owner of Twitter/X from 2022. A grounded entity the source-entity's events pull in by following grounding edges.

concepts.name: acquisition
concepts.gloss: a FINANCE event: one party BUYS another (a transfer of ownership for money). Grounds in transfer + finance. The Musk acquisition of Twitter ($44B) is an instance.

concepts.name: finance
concepts.gloss: the domain of money, capital, valuation, debt — what a $44B acquisition grounds in. A grounded concept the acquisition event pulls into the cone.

concepts.name: politics
concepts.gloss: the domain of power, governance, partisanship, public influence — what the owner's public role and the platform's moderation stance pull in. A grounded concept the trust-relevant events reach.

concepts.name: public_trust
concepts.gloss: the EPISTEMIC weight a public audience extends to a source — how firmly its content is taken as reliable. Grounds in knowledge/belief. The trust-relevant events (moderation change, verification-for-pay, an AI-output incident) MOVE it; the source-context's trust is COMPOSED over those events up to the artifact's date, not a constant.

concepts.name: content_moderation
concepts.gloss: the REGIME by which a platform governs what may be posted/amplified — the gatekeeping that bears on how reliable its content is. A change to it is a TRUST-relevant event grounding in public_trust + politics.

concepts.name: verification_badge
concepts.gloss: a platform's IDENTITY-verification signal (a 'blue check'). When it shifts from vetted-identity to a PAID subscription, it stops certifying identity — a TRUST-relevant change grounding in public_trust.

concepts.name: ai_output_incident
concepts.gloss: an incident in which the platform's own AI produced extreme/harmful output (the Grok 'MechaHitler' incident, 2025-07) — a TRUST-relevant grounded event bearing on the platform's reliability/safety, grounding in public_trust + politics.

concepts.name: twitter_x
concepts.gloss: the social-media platform founded 2006 as TWITTER, acquired by Elon Musk 2022-10 ($44B), renamed to X 2023-07. A TEMPORAL ENTITY: its NAME, OWNER, verification regime, moderation regime and public trust CHANGE across a dated TIMELINE of events (each a grounded fact). The CONTEXT of a post is the entity's grounding cone TIME-SLICED to the post's date — so a 2015 tweet and a 2024 X post DERIVE DIFFERENT contexts (different name/owner/implied-web/trust) from the SAME surface form. is-a temporal_entity (is-a source); built_from social_media_platform + public_square. The TIMELINE is the agent's INPUT (grounded facts); the context is DERIVED by composing the time-sliced cone — NO hand-fed reliability constant.

timeline._doc: The TIMELINE of dated EVENTS — the agent's grounded-fact INPUTS. Each event has a WHEN (ISO date), a KIND, the concepts it GROUNDS IN (grounds_in — the agent follows these grounding edges to IMPLY the web: musk -> finance, politics; an acquisition -> finance; an incident -> public_trust), optional STATE it sets (sets_name / sets_owner — the entity's name/owner from that date), and a TRUST signal (trust_relevant + trust_dir: +1 raises, -1 lowers — the source-context's trust is COMPOSED over the trust-relevant in-cone events, NOT a hand-set number). The CONTEXT for a given WHEN composes the cone over the events with when <= that date.

events.label: blue check becomes a paid subscription (no longer certifies identity)

concepts.name: social_media_platform
concepts.gloss: a platform on which any user PUBLISHES short messages to a public/social audience (self-published, no editorial gatekeeping). A source GENRE: content is self-published — generally LOW baseline reliability (an individual's claim, not an attested/consensus one), highly variable. Grounds in public_square.

concepts.name: public_square
concepts.gloss: a shared public SPACE where anyone may speak to anyone — the agora. The thing a social-media platform IS, structurally (open, many-to-many, self-published). Grounds in communication_act (people SAY words to a public).

concepts.name: jack_dorsey
concepts.gloss: a person — Twitter's co-founder and the platform's owner/CEO in its founding era (pre-2022, before the Musk acquisition). The owner a pre-2022 tweet's context resolves to. is-a agent.

concepts.name: action
concepts.gloss: an agent DOES something. NSM DO.

concepts.name: event
concepts.gloss: something HAPPENS (an occurrence, no agent required). NSM HAPPEN.

concepts.name: motion
concepts.gloss: an entity MOVES (changes place). NSM MOVE.

concepts.name: transfer
concepts.gloss: an agent gives a theme to a recipient.

concepts.name: change_of_state
concepts.gloss: an entity BECOMES different (X becomes Y).

concepts.name: creation
concepts.gloss: an agent brings a theme into existence.

concepts.name: aspect_ongoing
concepts.gloss: the situation is IN PROGRESS (imperfective/progressive).

concepts.name: aspect_completed
concepts.gloss: the situation is COMPLETE (perfective).

concepts.name: aspect_habitual
concepts.gloss: the situation RECURS as a rule (habitual).

concepts.name: phase_begin
concepts.gloss: the situation BEGINS (inchoative).

concepts.name: phase_end
concepts.gloss: the situation ENDS (cessative).

concepts.name: possibility
concepts.gloss: it CAN/MAY be the case (epistemic/circumstantial possibility). NSM CAN/MAYBE.

concepts.name: necessity
concepts.gloss: it MUST be the case (necessity).

concepts.name: ability
concepts.gloss: an agent is ABLE to do something.

concepts.name: permission
concepts.gloss: an agent is ALLOWED to do something (deontic).

concepts.name: obligation
concepts.gloss: an agent SHOULD/MUST do something (deontic).

concepts.name: intention
concepts.gloss: an agent INTENDS/will do something.

concepts.name: time_now
concepts.gloss: the present moment. NSM NOW.

concepts.name: time_before
concepts.gloss: A is BEFORE B (precedence). NSM BEFORE.

concepts.name: time_after
concepts.gloss: A is AFTER B. NSM AFTER.

concepts.name: time_during
concepts.gloss: A occurs WHILE/DURING B (overlap).

concepts.name: tense_past
concepts.gloss: the situation holds BEFORE now.

concepts.name: tense_present
concepts.gloss: the situation holds AT now.

concepts.name: tense_future
concepts.gloss: the situation holds AFTER now.

concepts.name: duration
concepts.gloss: the situation lasts for an amount of time (long/short).

concepts.name: frequency
concepts.gloss: how often the situation recurs.

concepts.name: space_here
concepts.gloss: the location of the speaker (proximal place). NSM HERE.

concepts.name: space_above
concepts.gloss: figure is ABOVE ground. NSM ABOVE.

concepts.name: space_below
concepts.gloss: figure is BELOW ground. NSM BELOW.

concepts.name: space_near
concepts.gloss: figure is NEAR ground (proximity). NSM NEAR/FAR.

concepts.name: space_inside
concepts.gloss: figure is INSIDE ground (containment). NSM INSIDE.

concepts.name: space_contact
concepts.gloss: figure TOUCHES ground (contact). NSM TOUCH.

concepts.name: space_direction
concepts.gloss: a path toward/away from a ground (to/from).

concepts.name: comparison_more
concepts.gloss: X has MORE of a property than Y (comparative-greater). NSM MORE.

concepts.name: comparison_less
concepts.gloss: X has LESS of a property than Y.

concepts.name: comparison_equal
concepts.gloss: X and Y are EQUAL in a property (as ... as).

concepts.name: superlative
concepts.gloss: X has the MOST of a property in a set.

concepts.name: intensifier
concepts.gloss: a property holds to a HIGH degree (very). NSM VERY.

concepts.name: similarity
concepts.gloss: X is LIKE Y (resemblance). NSM LIKE/AS.

concepts.name: sameness
concepts.gloss: X is THE SAME as Y. NSM THE SAME.

concepts.name: difference
concepts.gloss: X is OTHER than / different from Y. NSM OTHER/ELSE.

concepts.name: magnitude_big
concepts.gloss: an entity is BIG (large size/extent). NSM BIG.

concepts.name: magnitude_small
concepts.gloss: an entity is SMALL. NSM SMALL.

concepts.name: evaluation_good
concepts.gloss: something is GOOD (positive value). NSM GOOD.

concepts.name: evaluation_bad
concepts.gloss: something is BAD (negative value). NSM BAD.

concepts.name: truth_value
concepts.gloss: a proposition is TRUE / not-true. NSM TRUE.

concepts.name: agent
concepts.gloss: the doer/cause of an event.

concepts.name: patient
concepts.gloss: the entity acted upon / undergoing change.

concepts.name: theme
concepts.gloss: the entity in a state or being located/moved.

concepts.name: experiencer
concepts.gloss: the entity having a mental/perceptual state.

concepts.name: recipient
concepts.gloss: the entity that receives.

concepts.name: instrument
concepts.gloss: the means by which.

concepts.name: source
concepts.gloss: the origin/from.

concepts.name: goal
concepts.gloss: the destination/to.

concepts.name: owner
concepts.gloss: the possessor in a relational role (the of-argument).

concepts.name: value
concepts.gloss: the filler/value of a relational role.

concepts.name: property
concepts.gloss: the quality attributed to an entity.

concepts.name: kind
concepts.gloss: the class an entity belongs to.

concepts.name: deixis_speaker
concepts.gloss: the speaker (I/me). NSM I.

concepts.name: deixis_addressee
concepts.gloss: the addressee (you). NSM YOU.

concepts.name: indefinite_person
concepts.gloss: an unspecified person (someone). NSM SOMEONE.

concepts.name: indefinite_thing
concepts.gloss: an unspecified thing (something). NSM SOMETHING.

concepts.name: collective_people
concepts.gloss: people (a plural human collective). NSM PEOPLE.

concepts.name: deixis_proximal
concepts.gloss: this (proximal demonstrative). NSM THIS.

concepts.name: deixis_distal
concepts.gloss: that (distal demonstrative).

concepts.name: statement
concepts.gloss: assert a proposition as the case (assertive / give-information).

concepts.name: question
concepts.gloss: request information — a proposition with a queried slot (demand-information).

concepts.name: request
concepts.gloss: direct another to bring about an action/answer (directive / demand-goods).

concepts.name: offer
concepts.gloss: commit the speaker to a future act for the addressee (commissive / offer-goods).

concepts.name: expressive
concepts.gloss: express a psychological state about a state of affairs (thank/apologise/exclaim).

concepts.name: negation
concepts.gloss: it is NOT the case that. Reverses polarity. NSM NOT.

concepts.name: conjunction
concepts.gloss: both — A and B.

concepts.name: disjunction
concepts.gloss: either — A or B.

concepts.name: conditional
concepts.gloss: if A then B. NSM IF.

concepts.name: cause
concepts.gloss: A because B / B causes A. NSM BECAUSE.

concepts.name: definite_reference
concepts.gloss: a specific, identifiable entity (the).

concepts.name: indefinite_reference
concepts.gloss: a non-specific / first-mention entity (a).

concepts.name: universal_quantity
concepts.gloss: all / every. NSM ALL.

concepts.name: existential_quantity
concepts.gloss: some / at least one. NSM SOME.

concepts.name: singular_quantity
concepts.gloss: exactly one. NSM ONE.

concepts.name: plural_quantity
concepts.gloss: more than one (many/few). NSM MANY/MUCH.

concepts.name: oeis
concepts.gloss: the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS): a curated REFERENCE database of integer sequences, each with a prose definition/formula and its ground-truth values. Consulted by sequence-id (A-number) or by name. Authoritative + falsifiable for established integer sequences (the values verify any extracted formula). is-a reference_work.

provenance._doc: The PROVENANCE template the agent attaches to a fact it grounds by reading OEIS - WHERE/WHO/HOW/WHEN + the epistemic status, read off this held concept. WHERE is filled per-lookup (the A-number).

concepts.name: lmfdb
concepts.gloss: the L-functions and Modular Forms Database (LMFDB): a curated REFERENCE database of arithmetic objects (elliptic curves, modular forms, number fields, torsion subgroups). Consulted by object/field label. A database SCAN gives the EMPIRICAL/EXISTENCE maximum over the data (what is PRESENT); rigorous maximality (what exists ANYWHERE) is a classification theorem, read-cited separately. is-a reference_work.

provenance._doc: The PROVENANCE template the agent attaches to a fact it grounds by querying LMFDB - WHERE/WHO/HOW/WHEN + the epistemic status. WHERE is filled per-query (the field/object label). The fetched value is the EMPIRICAL max present in the database (existence), distinct from the rigorous classification maximum.
